invalid/not-json.json.why: The file isn't JSON: the last brace is missing.

invalid/not-utf8.json.why: The file isn't UTF-8: the name holds a Latin-1 byte.

invalid/byte-order-mark.json.why: The file starts with a byte order mark.

invalid/repeated-key.json.why: An object holds the same key twice, so its finish can't be told.

invalid/format-other.json.why: The format name is another name.

invalid/format-version-not-a-number.json.why: The format version is a string, not a whole number.

invalid/lots-missing.json.why: The list of lots is missing.

invalid/profile-name-blank.json.why: The profile's name is empty after trimming.

invalid/currency-lower-case.json.why: The currency isn't three upper-case letters.

invalid/entry-source-id-missing.json.why: A lot's entry has no source id.

invalid/entry-name-missing.json.why: A lot's entry lacks a descriptive field.

invalid/finish-left-out.json.why: A lot's finish is left out; not recorded is written as null.

invalid/condition-empty.json.why: A lot's condition is an empty string; not recorded is written as null.

invalid/price-one-place.json.why: A lot's price paid has one decimal place.

invalid/time-with-offset.json.why: A time is written with an offset, not with Z.

invalid/time-not-a-moment.json.why: A time has the right form but is no real moment: 30 February.

invalid/changed-before-added.json.why: A lot was last changed before it was added.

invalid/duplicate-lot.json.why: Two lots have the same lot identity; only their quantities differ.

invalid/locations-missing.json.why: The locations list is missing from a version 2 file.

invalid/locations-not-a-list.json.why: The locations are an object, not a list.

invalid/locations-501.json.why: The list holds 501 locations; at most 500 are allowed.

invalid/location-name-61.json.why: A location's name is 61 code points long; at most 60 are allowed.

invalid/location-name-padded.json.why: A location's name has a space at its start and at its end.

invalid/location-name-double-space.json.why: A location's name has two spaces in a row.

invalid/location-name-tab.json.why: A location's name has a tab between its words, a White_Space character other than a space.

invalid/location-name-no-break-space.jso.why: A location's name has a no-break space (U+00A0) between its words.

invalid/location-name-ideographic-space..why: A location's name has an ideographic space (U+3000) between its words.

invalid/location-name-next-line.json.why: A location's name has a next line character (U+0085) between its words.

invalid/location-name-line-separator.jso.why: A location's name has a line separator (U+2028) between its words.

invalid/location-name-control.json.why: A location's name has a control character (U+0007).

invalid/location-name-format.json.why: A location's name has a zero width space (U+200B), a format character.

invalid/location-duplicate-case.json.why: Two locations have names that differ only in case.

invalid/location-duplicate-fold.json.why: Two locations have names that differ only by full case folding (ß and SS).

invalid/location-duplicate-nfd.json.why: Two locations hold the same name in NFC and in NFD.
